replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Well, yes, you are allowed to make maps for Survival Games, but the standards for it are pretty high actually, because if we were to add any more maps (44 currently), it must be a map that stands out from the rest and provides seriously good gameplay and aesthetics. I'm not sure about the dimensions, just make sure the map isn't excessively small or huge, as we don't want it to play bad. Something special... I guess secret areas make it fun! Use redstone, hidden stuff, trapped chests, anything your evil mind desires!

@miningflamingo: Search 'em up on Google.
